items.title: RI1FJZ underway: Apostol Andrey clears Kola Bay for Franz Josef Land
items.blurb: Yacht Apostol Andrey cast off from Murmansk late 7 September. At 0600Z it was 69°25′N 34°01′E — Kola Bay astern, Kildin Island passed — steering north-east at 5.4 knots with about 700 miles left to Alexandra Land. Arrival eyed 13–14 September; 9 September is the windiest stretch (20–30 kt on a broad reach). On-air still planned after landfall with up to seven radios, EME, LEO, and QO-100.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile 800 MHz trial ends 12 September; 70 cm still contested
items.blurb: FCC gave AST SpaceMobile until 12 September to finish its direct-to-device cellular trial on 817–824 / 862–869 MHz in Lanham, Maryland and Midland, Texas. Separately, amateurs keep watching the earlier limited 430–440 MHz emergency TT&C grant: SatNOGS observers report ops outside those terms and 70 cm interference in North America and Europe as the constellation grows past three birds.

items.title: Ofcom opens WRC-27 call for input through 24 November
items.blurb: Published 1 September: UK provisional views and positions for ITU WRC-27 (Shanghai, Oct/Nov 2027). Ofcom wants comments on how those positions should evolve; response form closes 24 November 2026. AMSAT-UK flagged the consultation for satellite and amateur spectrum watchers — useful reading ahead of CEPT prep.

items.title: ARISS tip: Doppler-shift the 437.800 MHz ISS voice repeater
items.blurb: Tuesday science tip from ARISS: the ISS voice repeater always transmits on 437.800 MHz, but you may not hear it exactly there. As the station moves across the sky the downlink appears to shift — Doppler — so retuning during the pass can recover more of each contact. Crossband stays 145.990 up (PL 67) / 437.800 down when live.

items.title: WN5C: compact 2.5 m base-loaded vertical for quick POTA
items.blurb: Sam WN5C rebuilds the AliExpress JPC-12 ecosystem around a 2.5 m whip: JPC coil + red base for 40–10 m, then a dedicated red-base FT50-6 toroid (28 turns of 24 AWG) for a packable 20 m-only stick. Two 17-ft radials and a ground spike; about $30–50 if you already own parts. Backyard and mid-day park tests both made contacts when prop was soft.

items.title: VE3YTX: get on the air — CW practice apps are not enough
items.blurb: Josh VE3YTX stopped waiting for perfect callsign copy and activated CA-5359 (Dundas Valley) with a QMX, EFHW, and K6ARK paddle. First outing was messy; a week later two clean CW QSOs (WD5EEI, N0RZ) plus FT8 finished the park. Hunters slowed to match him. HamAlert invite if you want to hear a beginner activator learning live.

items.title: K4A ‘We Do Remember’ returns tomorrow, 9–13 September
items.blurb: Alabama Contest Group’s sixth-year K4A special event marks 25 years since 9/11. Volunteer ops take shifts starting 9 September; they want on-air memories and will pause for named tributes. Special QSL; stories go into the club newsletter. Want a shift? Email Bob WA1FCN at wa1fcn@charter.net.
